text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neither of them was able to claim
victory. Yet though both suffered a loss,
there was 
a profound difference in the brilliance
at the core of their running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose,
having lofty aspirations with 
eyes fixed firmly on the goal. That is 
something Hishi Miracle does not possess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Could she truly keep up with all of this 
going forward?
Hishi Miracle was seized by 
intense anxiety.
